name: Kuonji Hiyori
source:
She is the daughter of the president of Kuonji Corporation, a major general trading company run by her father.

Her mother died when she was very young and so she was only raised by her dad, resulting in her being relatively naïve. She tends to be reserved and shy, but once she gets used to people, she becomes a friendly rabbit-like girl. She is also a clumsy girl who sometimes spins out of control when she rushes forward. Her hobby is making coffee, and is very particular about the beans and blends.

Her dream is to become a certified barista and open a coffee shop with a wonderful husband. While studying for her certification, she works part-time at the cafeteria of Shiraba Academy, but is not good at serving customers.

She has been best friends with Ichika for a long time and has a crush on her brother, Ren. She sometimes has girly delusions of falling in love, causing her to blush heavily.

"Senpai, I will become a good bride! ...Ah! T-T-That was just a joke!"
